title: Webhooks survive a noisy tenant
outcome: One tenant sending too many webhooks slows only itself: it is rate-limited with a clear answer, every other tenant is served as before, and operators can see who is being limited.

criteria.text: A tenant over its limit gets 429 with a Retry-After header
Other tenants are served as before
The audit log names each limited tenant

proof.ref: An operator reads the audit log after a load test

decisions.text: Do retries of a failed webhook count towards the limit? Answer: Retries do not count
